subject: Request: reserve sprint slot for Zenith Health compliance deliverable
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: reserve sprint slot for Zenith Health compliance deliverable

Team —

Heads-up: Zenith Health (Alex Perez copied below) is in final negotiation and expects the feature we discussed — per-tenant KV/cache isolation + configurable data retention rules + an audit-log export endpoint — as a condition of signature. Legal and procurement have flagged this as an enablement item in the mutual action plan. They want an ETA and a commitment window by end of day Monday so they can close with their exec sponsor.

Ask: can Eng/Product commit to a sprint slot in Feb (week of Feb 8) to deliver an MVP that meets their minimum compliance checklist? If full scope is risky we should agree a phased approach (MVP: tenant isolation + retention config; Phase 2: managed export & extended audit retention).

Attached: Zenith_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf (summary, highlights the compliance acceptance criteria). Also have a spreadsheet with the security items (zenith_security_requirements.xlsx).

Why priority: deal ACV $1.2M ARR first-year, expansion potential to 3x. If we miss the user-acceptance date they will escalate with competing vendors — this is a strategic enterprise logo.

Please advise on feasibility and what you need from Sales to reduce scope or accept technical tradeoffs. If you prefer, I can push back on the customer for a phased delivery agreement but need dates to communicate.

Grace
Grace O'Connor | Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachment: Zenith_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf (pdf, 248 KB)
Attachment: zenith_security_requirements.xlsx (xlsx, 112 KB)

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: reserve sprint slot for Zenith Health compliance deliverable

Thanks Grace — important context. Quick thoughts after a first pass on the attachments:

- Per-tenant KV/cache isolation: feasible as a config-driven runtime isolation (routing + namespace separation). Low to medium effort depending on whether they need hard isolation (separate processes/pools) or logical isolation within same pool.
- Retention rules: straightforward to add retention flags per-tenant for short-term retention (N days). Longer compliance windows will require storage-tiering work.
- Audit-log export endpoint: depends on format, frequency, and retention guarantees. We need detail on whether they require push to their S3 (signed URL) vs. a one-off download.

Risk: If they require strict data residency or separate VPC connectivity we may need Private deployment work and infra tickets (higher scope).

Can you clarify the MUST vs. NICE-TO-HAVE items in the spreadsheet (zenith_security_requirements.xlsx)? If Sales can sign them into the MAP as phased items we can aim for an MVP in the Feb 8 sprint and deliver the export in Phase 2 (targeting late Mar).

Action items for Sales: 1) Confirm which items are deal-breakers vs. later phases. 2) If deal-breakers include hard isolation or on-prem connectors, flag so Eng can scope private-deploy work.

I'll sync with Product planning today and post back with a capacity ask (we may need 2 backend engs + 1 infra for 2 sprints for full scope).

— Dev
Dev Patel
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 13:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: reserve sprint slot for Zenith Health compliance deliverable

Adding more sales context so engineering can triage properly:

- Deal size: $1.2M ARR first year, onboarding fee $150k. Vendor risk: Zenith procurement has a clause that allows them to pause the contract if compliance milestones aren't met within 60 days of signature.
- Customer timeline: Legal needs a firm date to present to their CIO (they're asking for "delivery in calendar quarter Q1").
- Exec sponsor: Tina Cho, VP Platform (copied in the HubSpot MAP).

MUST-HAVE (Zenith says they will not sign without these): per-tenant isolation for audit reasons; retention policy configurable to 90/180 days; basic audit-log export (CSV push to customer S3).
NICE-TO-HAVE: continuous streaming export, on-prem connector.

We have some flexibility on the export format (they said CSV/S3 is fine). If Eng can commit to an MVP that includes logical isolation + configurable retention + a manual export endpoint, legal will accept that as Phase 1. They want Phase 2 scope and timeline documented in the MAP.

If Product needs a signed commitment from Sales (e.g., tradeoffs accepted), tell me exact language and I'll get the customer to sign the phased delivery clause in the MAP.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

On Fri, Jan 15, 2027 at 11:03 AM Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Grace — important context...

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: reserve sprint slot for Zenith Health compliance deliverable

Looping in capacity planning notes. FYI: current roadmap sprint capacity for Feb (week of Feb 8) is ~60% booked with planned work (runtime perf improvements, autoscaling fixes). We do have a couple of low-risk items that could be deferred, but taking on the full Zenith scope as-is will require re-prioritization.

Estimate (ballpark):
- MVP (logical isolation + retention flags + manual CSV export endpoint): ~2 engineer-sprints (backend+infra). With priority scheduling we can land an MVP by end of Feb (Feb 26).
- Full isolation (separate pools or dedicated capacity options) + managed export and extended retention windows: +2 to 3 sprints, depends on infra/VPC work.

If Sales signs a phased MAP and agrees to an explicit Phase 2 timeline + acceptance criteria, I can push for a reserved slot (reduce risk) but need signoff by EOD Wed so planning can adjust.

Rishi
Director, Product Planning

> On Fri, Jan 15, 2027 at 09:12 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Team —
> > 
> > Heads-up: Zenith Health (Alex Perez copied below) is in final negotiation...

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: reserve sprint slot for Zenith Health compliance deliverable

Thanks — appreciate the estimates.

Decision recap for the thread and actions for Sales:
- Agree to a phased delivery in the MAP. Phase 1 (MVP): logical per-tenant isolation + configurable retention (90/180) + manual CSV export (push to signed S3 URL). Target: delivery by Feb 26.
- Phase 2: dedicated pool option and streaming/export improvements targeted for end of Mar / early Apr.

Marissa: please update the MAP with the phased language (I suggest: "Buyer acknowledges that certain features will be delivered in Phase 2; Seller will provide an estimated delivery window and acceptance criteria for Phase 2 within 30 days of contract execution."). Get Tina to initial/sign. I will verbally commit to the Feb 26 MVP in today's exec call.

Rishi/Dev: please tentatively reserve the Feb 8 sprint capacity and confirm any blockers by EOD Thu so we can finalize plan. If you need anything from Legal or Security to unblock, ping me.

Grace
Grace O'Connor | Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
